correctness.rationale: For every q>0, all five latencies are continuous/nonnegative/nondecreasing and f is any Wardrop flow. The Wardrop average equals qL; if an outer count increases, an originally used shortest U/D/M path weakly decreases in cost, giving psi<=eps. When both outer counts decrease, f_U,f_D>0; direct edge-cost cancellation gives c_U(g)+c_D(g)=c_M(g)+L-R with each term of R nonnegative. Since g_M>f_M and its path cost is at most the minimum outer cost plus eps, min path cost<=L+eps-R and psi<=2eps-R. Equality forces R=0, c_U(g)=c_D(g)=L+eps, c_M(g)=L+2eps, g_U=g_D=0 and every stated plateau. The converse reproduces these exact values. Independent exact-Fraction checks covered 5040 rational-affine Wardrop comparison cases and the nonaffine sharp instance with theta=3/4; checked the full proof, not inferred an infinite result from finite tests.
residual_risks: Finite rational checks do not cover arbitrary nondecreasing continuous latencies; algebraic monotonicity proof does. Equality is only characterized when eps>0 and for the fixed directed one-commodity five-edge network.
